resolution: Animated water in the compiled no-V8 game. Each body ships a WATER lump (a flat surface-level height grid per body + shared look/wave in the header); world_loader.zig renders each as a translucent heightfield and gpu/3d.zig's hfGen applies a travelling sine wave sourced from the host clock, re-baked every frame by resolveDynamicHeightfield (a non-zero wave amplitude forces the re-bake) — so the surface ripples with no per-frame data/JS in the shipped game. The heightfield skirt to the basin floor keeps it a wadeable volume, color_a<1 routes it through the existing transparent pass, and water is kept out of scene.heightfields so it never becomes a collider. Touched lumps.ts/mapfile.zig (WATER id 21), worldGeometry.encodeWaterBodies (dropped the static instance bake), packageMap, constructor.zig (WaterField/decodeWater/Scene.water), layout.zig (Node wave fields), 3d.zig (HfWave+hfGen+rebake), world_loader.zig (water node). zig fmt clean; encode/decode byte layout verified. NEEDS the no-V8 loader rebuilt to see it. Shared framework files also carried a co-session MESH_PROPS feature (complete) that rode along.
